PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 21, 2024
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Gina Maguire, President  Naiomi Rainey, Commissioner
Kevin Scott, Vice President  Robert Shannon, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 CALL TO ORDER

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-55651  Recommendation to approve November 7, 2024 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  24-55652  Recommendation to approve Transfer of Funds for November 21, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  24-55653  Recommendation to adopt Resolution UT-1524 authorizing the General Manager to
  execute an agreement, and any necessary documents and subsequent
  amendments, with Dell Marketing L.P., of Round Rock, Texas, for furnishing and
  delivering Microsoft product licenses and support services, on the same terms and
  conditions afforded to the County of Riverside, California, through the Licensed
  Support Provider (LSP) Agreement No. ITARC-00934 and Riverside County Master
  Microsoft Enterprise Agreement No. 8084445, in an annual amount of $75,000 with
  a $30,000 contingency, for a total annual contract amount not to exceed $105,000,
  until the County of Riverside contract expires on October 31, 2027, with the option
  to renew for as long as the County of Riverside contract is in effect.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  24-55654  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to sign and file all necessary
  documents associated with the United States Department of Transportation’s Fiscal
  Year 2024 Natural Gas Distribution Infrastructure Safety and Modernization Grant
  Program. Long Beach Utilities Department was awarded $6,806,640 to replace a
  12-inch steel pipeline on the Anaheim Street Bridge.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 5.  24-55655  Receive and file Lead and Copper Rule Compliance update.

  Page 1 of 3
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 21, 2024
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Suggested Action:  Receive and file.

6.  24-55656  Receive and file information from the After-Action Report regarding Main Break and
  Boil Water Notice.

  Suggested Action:  Receive and file.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Dynna Long, Executive Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, or if you need the agenda provided in an alternate format, please call the Board
of Public Utilities Commissioners Executive Assistant at (562) 570-2435 or (562) 570-6626
(telecommunications for the deaf) by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.

  Page 2 of 3

NOTE:

accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, please make your request

kung nais ang isang natatanging tulong ayon sa Americans with Disabilities Act, mangyaring
isagawa ang iyong hiling sa pamamagitan ng telepono sa Opisina ng Clerk ng Lungsod sa (562)

Si desea interpretación oral en otro idioma para personas que no hablan inglés o si desea una
adaptación especial en conformidad con la Ley de Estadounidenses con Discapacidades, haga su

If written language translation of the Commission agenda and minutes for non-English speaking

Si desea obtener la traducción escrita en otro idioma de la agenda y actas de la comisión para
